statement.zh: 希巴（拉格什本城）大都会/纽大 Wolfe 队 1968–1969 第一季记录了建筑与出土，见 Hansen 1970（Artibus Asiae 32/4）。
statement.en: At Tell al-Hiba (Lagash city proper), the 1968–1969 first season of the Met/NYU Wolfe Expedition recorded architecture and finds, as documented in Hansen 1970 (Artibus Asiae 32/4).
